question: Do the independently evidenced faction-conversion package and directionally valid late-Customer recognition schedule jointly satisfy faction parity and strategic-diversity bounds at every supported player count without making an action or winning path compulsory?
requiredDiagnostics: faction win-share range and standings by supported player count
winner share and attribution by classified path
Mandate sources and Core Action selections by winning path
Demis, Elon, Jensen, and Mark paired movement
dominance, pairwise cycles, integrity, fallbacks, and forced no-ops

selectionRule.eligiblePackage: The candidate package must keep every supported player count at or below the 15-point faction win-share range, at or above 0.60 winning-path entropy, at or below 0.55 winning-path top share, inside all action and opening bounds, and free of registered dominance, integrity failure, fallbacks, or excessive forced no-ops.
selectionRule.rejectPackage: Reject the four-lever package if any supported player count fails a declared outcome bound, if Mark's distribution identity becomes nonviable, if Deploy or Research becomes compulsory, or if one faction correction reverses at a supported count.
selectionRule.interpretation: This is interaction validation, not new causal one-lever evidence. Failure requires attribution before any new candidate; success still does not auto-promote physical rules.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: Explicit user approval and controlled physical play remain mandatory.
